exact_semantic_question: When LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR is empty, is the row a numeric limit, report-only monitoring, or something else?
relation_contract: empty numeric limit must be classified before comparison; absence is not a denial

candidate_interpretations.label: numeric_limit
candidate_interpretations.statement: Empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR still denotes an enforceable numeric effluent limit row suitable for numeric comparison once the value is recovered from elsewhere.

candidate_interpretations.label: report_only_monitoring
candidate_interpretations.statement: Empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR denotes a monitoring/reporting requirement without a numeric effluent limit for that statistical-base cell (permit table 'Report' or equivalent).

candidate_interpretations.label: non_applicable_limit_column
candidate_interpretations.statement: Empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR marks a non-applicable limit-table column (for example N/A mass-load base) while a sibling row carries the numeric limit for comparison.

candidate_interpretations.label: special_non_numeric_reporting
candidate_interpretations.statement: Empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR marks a non-standard reporting obligation (pass/fail WET encoding or geometric-mean aggregated reporting) that is not an ordinary numeric concentration limit.

retained_snippets.location: aggregate over 57 rows with empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR
retained_snippets.text: 57/105 permit_limits rows have empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR; all have LIMIT_TYPE_CODE=ENF; all have empty LIMIT_VALUE_QUALIFIER_CODE; partition by DMR_COMMENT_TEXT: blank 18, WHEN DISCHARGING. 12, PASS=0/FAIL=1 12, geometric mean 15; zero rows have nonempty LIMIT_VALUE_STANDARD_UNITS when LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR is empty.
retained_snippets.why_retained: Establishes that empty-limit rows are heterogeneous and never carry a populated standard-units comparison value despite ENF typing.

contradictory_evidence: All 57 empty-limit rows carry LIMIT_TYPE_CODE=ENF, which could be read as enforceable limit rows rather than monitoring-only rows.
Empty-limit WET retest rows include OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG=Y on some schedules, which could suggest optional rather than strictly report-only treatment.

Sibling numeric limits on the same LIMIT_ID mean empty rows occur in limit sets that also contain numeric comparison candidates, so emptiness alone does not identify report-only status without permit-table or comment context.
known_limitations: No ICIS/NPDES codebook or field legend in the workspace defines LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR emptiness semantics directly.
PASS=0/FAIL=1 instructions for WET retest rows appear in structured DMR_COMMENT_TEXT but were not found in the extracted farmington final_permit.txt text searched within budget.
Only 3 of 12 permit-package documents were opened; not every empty-limit row was individually matched to permit-table text.
FY2025 DMR measurements contain zero rows with empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR, so Purpose A comparison blocking is inferred from permit_limit structure rather than observed FY2025 DMR joins.
